generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work related to 3-phase Industrial Electrical works in any power generating station OR processing industry OR reputed organization costing not less than Rs. 8.08 lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any one of the preceding five years period. Work order and Work done certificates shall be enclosed as a documentary proof issued by the competent authority.

The intending bidder in his name should have in the preceding five years period, achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.16.15 lakhs (exclusive of GST) the bidder shall furnish the TURNOVER CERTIFICATE with Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) and profit & loss statement duly certified by charted accountant as a documentary proof. On demand, originals shall be produced for verification Copy of turnover certificate from competent Auditor / Auditors report along with the Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss statements shall be enclosed as a documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have a valid Class-I and above Electrical contractor license issued by Electrical Inspectorate/competent authority. If the electrical license is issued by other than State Government of Karnataka, the bidder should get Electrical License OR Consent Letter from Electrical Inspectorate to Government of Karnataka within two months from the date of issue of Work order. A Declaration to this effect shall be furnished by the intending bidder along with the bid as per ANNEXURE II

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing 3-phase welding power receptacles to belt conveyors and JNTs at BTPS unit-3 CHP

itemList.description: Supply of Armoured LT Cables: Supply of 3.5C x 95 sq.mm armoured LT power cable, conforming to the detailed technical specifications of the tender

Laying of Armoured LT Cables :Laying, dressing and fixing of armoured LT power cable of size 3.5C x 95 sq.mm to 3.5C x 120 sq.mm in the existing cable tray /trench/ wall/ structure/ duct etc complete in all respects as per detailed technical specification of the tender

Termination of Armoured LT cables: Termination, dressing, and fixing of 3.5Cx95 sq.mm LT armoured cable with cable glands and crimping of lugs [LILO basis] as per detailed technical specification fo the tender

Welding receptacle : Supply and fixing outdoor type 100A 3-phase welding receiptacle consists of SFU, bus bar, TB, indicating lamps etc. The receptacle shall be fixed on steel structure / concrete wall with all welding / grouting etc. . The receiptacles shall be commissioned with cable termination with suitable glands and lugs on LILO basis as per detailed technical specification fo the tender.
